name: ECO-VERIFY
evidence: gate_data.adjudicate_history has latest verdicts with score and decision
gatekeeper-cli.sh self-check reports context_injection PASS or WARN only
exit gate is composite: audit --all must pass before docgen runs

structural_checks.command: bash gatekeeper-cli.sh state 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);adj=d.get('gate_data',{}).get('adjudicate_history',[]);print('PASS' if len(adj)>0 else 'FAIL')"
bash gatekeeper-cli.sh state 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);er=d.get('gate_data',{}).get('entropy_rate','0.0');print('PASS' if float(er)<0.5 else 'BLOCKED')"

bash gatekeeper-cli.sh self-check 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print('PASS' if any(c.get('check')=='key_integrity' and c.get('status')=='PASS' for c in d.get('checks',[])) else 'FAIL')"
